title: Framework Desktop, 192 GB bellek ve Ryzen AI işlemciyle ön siparişe çıkıyor
summary: Wccftech'in aktardığına göre, Framework'ün AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 işlemci ve 192 GB bellek barındıran yeni masaüstü bilgisayarı bu çarşamba ön siparişe açılıyor.
body:
Framework Desktop, 192 GB bellek ve Ryzen AI işlemciyle ön siparişe çıkıyor. Wccftech'in aktardığına göre, Framework'ün yeni masaüstü bilgisayarı AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 işlemci ve 192 GB birleşik bellek kapasitesiyle bu çarşamba ön siparişe sunulacak.

## Donanım özellikleri ve kapasite

Şirketin daha önce AMD'nin etkinliğinde ön gösterimini yaptığı bu üst düzey sistem, 16 adet Zen 5 çekirdeğine ve 5.2 GHz çalışma frekansına sahip güncellenmiş **AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495** çipini kullanıyor. Grafik tarafında ise 3.0 GHz hızında çalışan 40 RDNA 3.5 çekirdekli Radeon 8065S yer alıyor. Sistem, saniyede 273 GB bant genişliği sunan 192 GB LPDDR5X birleşik bellekle donatılmış durumda.

Framework, sistemin yapay zeka dil modelleri için optimize edildiğini ve tek bir kutuda DeepSeek V4-Flash modelini çalıştırabildiğini belirtiyor. Ayrıca açık uçlu PCIe yuvaları sayesinde kullanıcıların daha büyük kartlar takabilmesine olanak tanınıyor. Artan bellek maliyetleri nedeniyle bu modelin mevcut 128 GB'lık versiyona kıyasla belirgin bir fiyat artışıyla gelmesi bekleniyor.

**Neden önemli?** Yapay zeka ve profesyonel iş yükleri için tasarlanan bu yüksek kapasiteli masaüstü bilgisayar, yerel yapay zeka modellerini tek bir cihazda çalıştırmak isteyenler için güçlü bir alternatif oluşturuyor.

source_texts.text:
Framework has announced that its AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 Desktop with 192 GB memory will be available for pre-order this Wednesday.
AI Crunching AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 PCs Are Rolling Out Now With Framework's Desktop With 192 GB Memory Aiming Wednesday For Pre-Orders
Yesterday, we covered a handful of announcements from AMD partners on their latest AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 systems.
These top-of-the-line designs featuring impressive capabilities & 192GB of memory sure sound super enticing for AI users and professionals. There are going to be plenty of Ryzen AI MAX 400 systems to select from, with prices beyond the $5000 US mark, & Framework is also announcing the pre-order date for its upcoming Desktop PC.
Framework Desktop is the same system that the company previewed at AMD's Advancing AI event a few months back. The system comes packed with the AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 chip. This chip is an updated version of AMD's Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395, offering the same 16 Zen 5 cores but clocked at a higher 5.2 GHz frequency. The GPU is upgraded to the Radeon 8065S, which packs 40 RDNA 3.5 cores at 3.0 GHz.
For memory, the system packs an astonishing 192 GB of Unified memory, operating at 273 GB/s (8533 MT/s LPDDR5X), which is a 6.6% speed-up in memory speeds & bandwidth, and a 50% boost to capacity versus the Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 systems, which offered 256 GB/s bandwidth & up to 128 GB capacity.
According to Framework, the system is optimized for AI LLMs, running DeepSeek V4-Flash at Q8 on a single box, and there's room to spare for additional context length.
There are also several other improvements made to the new Framework AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 Desktop, such as the PCIe x4 slot being open-ended, which would allow users to plug in larger PCIe cards directly within the system. To showcase its open-ended PCIe slots, Framework set up a concept of a cluster using two 50 GbE NICs, which enable RDMA over Ethernet (RoCE). This offers ultra-low latency and makes it possible to effectively pool 384 GB of memory across two desktops with tensor parallelism.
The company will also introduce a pre-built version with a Linux distro pre-loaded. Framework has stated that as LPDDR5X prices continue to rise, the 192 GB Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 system will bring a substantial jump in cost over the existing 128 GB model, and recommends picking up a 32GB, 64GB, or 128GB model based on your budget.
AMD's Ryzen AI MAX+ 495 with 192 GB will eclipse existing 128 GB platforms such as NVIDIA's DGX Spark, which still retains 128 GB LP5X memory and costs close to $5000 US. The base price of the MAX+ 395 system from Framework is around $3500 US, and that's also what most 395+ PCs are selling for from other manufacturers. We have seen various pre-order prices starting above $6000 US, so we expect a similar ballpark for the Framework Desktop when it hits pre-orders this Wednesday.
